hero.subheadline: Artists of every level enter the Aesthetica Art Prize
hero.valueProposition: The main prize winner receives £10,000, a group exhibition at a major public gallery, and editorial coverage in Aesthetica Magazine.

content.whyJoin:
The Aesthetica Art Prize is an annual celebration of excellence in contemporary art, hosted by Aesthetica Magazine. It offers both emerging and established artists the opportunity to showcase their work to a wider audience and further their engagement with the international art world.

The prize accepts work in any genre and on any theme, with a particular interest in pieces that reflect upon an ever-changing world. Media include painting and drawing, video, sculpture, installation, performance, photography, digital art, artists' film, ceramics, illustration, and mixed media.

Winners receive £10,000 for the main prize and £1,000 for the emerging prize, with shortlisted artists included in a group exhibition at a major public gallery. Winning and shortlisted work is published in Aesthetica Magazine and the Aesthetica Art Prize Anthology, giving artists editorial coverage and an online profile.
content.whoShouldApply:
The Aesthetica Art Prize is open to all practitioners working at any level, including students, with no nationality restriction. Each entry includes two works of art, and entries can be purchased and submitted online from December 2025 through October 2026.

The competition looks for work that demonstrates innovation and creativity, redefines the parameters of contemporary art, and compels audiences. The main prize is open to all practitioners, while the emerging prize supports artists at an earlier stage of their careers.

This call suits artists who want a major public gallery exhibition, editorial coverage in a leading art magazine, and cash prizes that recognize and support their artistic practice.

faq.question: Who can enter the Aesthetica Art Prize?
faq.answer: The prize is open to all practitioners working at any level, including students, with no nationality restriction. Work in any genre and on any theme is accepted.

faq.question: How much does it cost to enter?
faq.answer: The regular entry fee is £25 and applies from December 1, 2025 to October 11, 2026. Late entries cost £35 and are accepted from October 12-18, 2026.

faq.question: What are the prizes?
faq.answer: The main prize winner receives £10,000, and the emerging prize winner receives £1,000. Winners and shortlisted artists are also included in a group exhibition at a major public gallery and receive editorial coverage in Aesthetica Magazine.

faq.question: What is the entry deadline?
faq.answer: Entries open on December 1, 2025 and the regular deadline is October 11, 2026. Late entries are accepted from October 12-18, 2026.

faq.question: What media are accepted?
faq.answer: The prize accepts painting and drawing, video, sculpture, installation, performance, photography, digital art, artists' film, ceramics, illustration, and mixed media. Each entry includes two works of art.

faq.question: When are the results announced?
faq.answer: Judging takes place during winter 2026, results are announced in spring 2027, and the exhibition follows later in 2027.

submissionGuide.detail: Buy your entry through the Aesthetica shop to register. The regular fee is £25, and the entry form is emailed to you upon registration.
Fill in the entry form with details of your two works of art, following the submission guidelines for images or video files.
Complete and return your entry form by October 11, 2026. Late entries are accepted until October 18 at the higher fee of £35.
An international panel reviews entries during winter 2026 to select the longlist, shortlist, and winners.
Winners are announced in spring 2027, and shortlisted work is presented in a group exhibition at a major public gallery.
